scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/icons && cp src/manifest.json src/background.js src/content.js src/popup.html src/popup.js dist/ && cp src/icons/*.png dist/icons/
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../laraselector-chrome.zip .
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && cd dist-firefox && zip -r ../laraselector-firefox.zip .
